Next.js: an empty site with a Next.js front end in web/, wired for preview, revalidation and member sign-in.

Create it

mkdir next && cd next
bunx @crombolo/cli@latest init --template next
bun install

Start it

bun run dev

This runs the CMS on http://localhost:8080/ and the Next.js front end in web/ on http://localhost:3000/.

The back office is at http://localhost:8080/crombolo, and the start prints how to sign in (Getting started).

What is in it

  • an empty site: no types or pages yet;
  • a Next.js app in web/, wired to the CMS for preview, cache revalidation when a page is published, and member sign-in.

Where to look first

Add a type and a page from the command line (A site from the command line), then render it in web/app/. The app reads the site through the Delivery API with @crombolo/delivery-client.
